title: NVIDIA ArtiFixer: diffusion repair for sparse 3D Gaussian reconstructions
summary: Official NVIDIA SIL repo for ArtiFixer (SIGGRAPH 2026): auto-regressive diffusion models that enhance and extend 3DGRUT-based reconstructions. Ships training, eval, and data-processing code plus Hugging Face checkpoints for repairing holes in splat captures.
question_it_answers: How do I repair sparse or incomplete 3D Gaussian splat reconstructions after capture?

claims.text: ArtiFixer uses auto-regressive diffusion to enhance and extend 3D reconstructions built on 3DGRUT.
claims.evidence: Enhancing and extending 3D reconstruction with auto-regressive diffusion models (SIGGRAPH 2026)
claims.subject: gaussian-splatting

claims.text: Hugging Face hosts artifixer-14b.pt (~16.9B) and artifixer-1.3b.pt (~1.68B) checkpoints.
claims.subject: gaussian-splatting

claims.text: leftover27 unused arXiv 2603.00492 abs 44,589 B names ArtiFixer (de Lutio et al.; SIGGRAPH 2026; v2 5 May 2026) and claims 1–3 dB PSNR over 3DGS baselines, with PDF artifixer.pdf listed at 91,742 KB. research.nvidia.com/labs/sil/projects/artifixer/ 18,793 B names ArtiFixer / ArtiFixer3D / ArtiFixer3D+ on MipNeRF 360, DL3DV, and Nerfbusters. huggingface.co/api/models/nvidia/ArtiFixer 850,636 B and 65 likes. leftover27 does not download the 91,742 KB PDF or rerun those PSNR tables.
